column1: # GENERATED by scripts/branch-archive.cjs — do not hand-edit.
# Every branch on origin, and where its commits survive if the branch is deleted.
#   in-main  the tip is an ancestor of main. Deleting the branch removes a name, not a commit.
#   pr-head  the tip is a refs/pull/N/head. GitHub keeps those permanently, merged or closed.
#   orphan   held by the branch name alone. These carry an archive tag; nothing else holds them.
# TO RECOVER ANY ROW — both verified on 2026-08-31 before this file was committed:
#   orphan   git fetch origin refs/tags/<archiveTag>:refs/tags/<archiveTag> && git log FETCH_HEAD
#   pr-head  git fetch origin refs/pull/<pr>/head && git log FETCH_HEAD
#   in-main  already in main; git show <sha>
# Ancestry alone is NOT the test: this repo squash-merges, so a merged branch tip is not an
# ancestor of main. git branch --no-merged reported 134 where the true orphan count was 74.
